CREATE FUNCTION [Application].DetermineCustomerAccess(@CityID int)
RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
RETURN (SELECT 1 AS AccessResult
        WHERE IS_ROLEMEMBER(N'db_owner') <> 0);
